verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a full webhooks subsystem with a defined event envelope (id, type, createdAt, payload, region), a documented set of supported event types (deployment created/succeeded/promoted/rollback/error/cancelled, project created/removed), and per-event payload references in the webhooks API docs, directly satisfying the subscribe-to-events story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and no explicit example of an AI agent itself registering/consuming a webhook subscription (evidence shows the mechanism but not an agent-specific use case).
